name: Melwen
source:
An elf hailing from the Great Forest.

Insatiably curious, she left the forest many years ago to become an adventurer. 

She's primarily conversant in the elf language so is unused to speaking in the human tongue. When she speaks to humans, her manner of speech resembles that of an adolescent girl.
